title: Watch live, take over, hand back, stop
spec: AT-058, AT-079, AT-272, J18; AT-078 external Edge close remains blocked

steps.text: Open the Indian Railways IRCTC website and check the train timings from New Delhi to Agra tomorrow morning

steps.note: AT-058/AT-079/AT-272: the browser job must first produce an actual plan or reply
AT-058/AT-079/AT-272: synchronize on the active browser job before opening its live viewer
AT-058/AT-272: pre-arm the live BrowserWindow event before opening the actual viewer

AT-079: the active live BrowserWindow exposes a masked picture
AT-079: the live window exposes the live state
AT-079: the live picture is marked masked
AT-058/AT-272: wait for the actual live control state
AT-058/AT-272: Take over moves the actual live window into control
AT-272: the hand-back control is visible in control mode
AT-058: control mode exposes exactly two live controls
AT-058: takeover is no longer offered once control is held
AT-272: control mode exposes the hand-back bar
AT-272: wait for the actual hand-back live state
AT-058/AT-272: hand back returns the live window to foo
